description: Create or update a reminder on a note. Pass `reminderId` to update an existing one (e.g. snooze by setting a new `triggerAt`); omit it to create a new one. Updating changes only the fields you pass: omitting `recurrence` keeps the existing recurrence, it does not clear it. A note can have multiple reminders. Reminder IDs come from get_note (its `reminders` array) or the response of a previous set_reminder.

noteId.description: The note to attach a NEW reminder to. Required when creating; ignored when updating (the reminder is found by reminderId).

recurrence.description: RRULE string for recurring reminders (e.g. 'FREQ=DAILY', 'FREQ=WEEKLY'). On update, omit to leave recurrence unchanged.

reminderId.description: Existing reminder ID to update. Omit to create a new reminder.

triggerAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the reminder should fire. Always include an explicit UTC offset, e.g. 2026-07-08T09:00:00-04:00 — a value with no offset is ambiguous. Confirm the intended local time with the user.

name: set_reminder

recurrence.description: RRULE string, null for one-shot reminders.
